name: build-macos-apps-browser-mirror
description: Open-source MIT derivative of OpenAI's Build macOS Apps plugin, adding a crisp local-only browser mirror for a selected native macOS window.

interface.shortDescription: Build macOS apps and inspect one native window in a crisp local browser mirror.
interface.longDescription: Independent, community-maintained MIT derivative of OpenAI's Build macOS Apps plugin. It retains the native macOS build and debugging workflows, and adds a ScreenCaptureKit-based, read-only browser mirror for one user-selected app window. Frames stay on localhost; the project is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.
interface.defaultPrompt: Build or debug a native macOS app, then mirror one selected window in Codex Browser.
